description: Search Studio's asset catalogs to find the ids needed to spawn things or drive characters. catalog='item' returns props/furniture/effects with the (group, category, no) triple required by studio_create_object; catalog='light' returns the light types with the 'no' required by studio_create_light; catalog='anime' returns the animation clips with the (group, category, no) triple required by studio_set_character_anime. Always call this before creating an object or setting an animation — ids cannot be guessed.

query.description: case-insensitive substring matched against the asset name, and (for items and animations) its group and category names. Omit to list everything up to 'limit'.

target.description: lights only: All, Chara or Map — what the light illuminates
